description: Apply a batch of Studio tool calls to a video doc and get back the updated doc plus a fresh scene description — YOU (this agent) are the brain, so this needs NO OpenRouter/AI key. Loop: call neuron_studio_catalog once, then neuron_studio_apply with { doc, calls:[{tool,args}] }, read the returned `scene`, apply more, and finally neuron_studio_render. Omit `doc` (with an optional `platform`) to start a fresh video.

activeIndex.description: Which scene subsequent layer calls target (default 0).

tool.description: A tool name from neuron_studio_catalog, e.g. add_text, animate_layer, add_overlay.

doc.description: The ProjectDoc to edit (omit to start fresh). Pass back the `doc` from the previous apply to keep going.

platform.description: Canvas size when starting fresh (default instagram-story).

name: neuron_studio_apply
title: Drive the Studio yourself (no AI key)
